scope: NCI-04G source-bound DEVELOPMENT feasibility only; not independently accepted science
code_preexistence: No NCI-04G replacement implementation exists in parent. This preregistration must precede all NCI-04G experiment code and results.
prohibited_after_primary_run: silently reclassifying a true negative as infrastructure failure
resource_acceptance: Record wall/CPU time, peak RSS, resident state and serialized bytes, training observations, prediction calls, intervention calls, rebuild/recovery work, message bytes where relevant. Any deterioration against the exact-parent conventional and native controls is NO-GO, not a hidden optimization trade.
question: Can a compact native learner discover discriminating interventions and correct causal-state mergers while preserving prior learned relations, rather than using an identity oracle or predefined diagnostic action list?
hypothesis: A bounded action-conditioned causal partition learner using consequence-derived uncertainty, learned intervention value, and retention-preserving split/revision will outperform its equal-information trained controls or match them at less resource cost on unseen source-free causal dynamics, without false identity assertions.
changed_paths: .ice/** (only if source-bound atlas regeneration becomes required)

frozen_design.split: Procedural families fixed before code: distinguishable hidden-state pairs with identical passive observations and one or more variable feature-conditioned informative actions; observationally identical nonidentifiable negative family; initially merged then contradicted consequence family; postrevision old-task and snapshot/restart reuse family. No hidden-state label supplied to target.
frozen_design.ordering: First train using 8 train seeds; freeze trained target and controls, test all 16 source-free development seeds once each including all stated families; report all failures without seed selection.
frozen_design.data_budget: At most 128 unlabeled action/outcome training episodes per seed and at most three test interventions per episode. Candidate and comparators see exactly the same experience; only candidate-controlled interventions may alter the common transcript, and action cost is charged to every model.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Identical training examples, update/evaluation passes, feature dimensions, and inference budgets; no external models, transformers as foundation, model API calls, oracle IDs, or learned-state growth above native exact-parent budget.
frozen_design.capacity: At most exact-parent cognition.LatentState serialized/resident footprint and MaxEntities=16 effective slots. Action affordances are runtime feature vectors; no fixed diagnostic action ID registry.
frozen_design.evaluator: Unambiguous heldout partition accuracy after chosen actions; abstention on observational-equivalence cases; causal prediction preservation after split; unchanged old-task performance on snapshot/restart; complete CPU/RSS/call/state ledger; frozen before running results.
frozen_design.source_birth: procedural source-free; exact generator hash and input manifest must be sealed before first primary evaluation, or classify INVALID
frozen_design.comparison_rule: candidate must beat strongest fully trained equal-information conventional control at equal/lower cost OR match its correct heldout decisions with at least 10% lower total CPU and no memory deterioration. Accuracy floor >= 12/16 distinguishable development cases. No hard false positives in nonidentifiable cases.

controls: fully trained conventional response-signature learner with abstention
fully trained bounded recurrent state learner under identical feature/data/compute budgets
original fixed NCI-04D2 latent binding native baseline

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT-FEASIBLE only if >=12/16 distinguishable cases correct, zero nonidentifiable hard false positives, >=95% pre-split correct old-task predictions retained after revision AND restart, candidate exceeds strongest fully trained equal-information comparator at equal/lower total cost OR equals accuracy with >=10% lower total CPU and no memory regression, and both split and learned-intervention ablations reduce heldout success.
classification_rules.mixed: Some necessary conditions pass but any controlled difference/retention/resource criterion lacks complete evidence. No scientific admission.
classification_rules.negative: All provenance valid and a necessary or comparison acceptance requirement fails, including ablations showing no causal contribution.
classification_rules.invalid: Any source drift, incomplete comparator training, oracle identity/action leakage, output-driven task or threshold revisions, missing resource ledger, changed data/compute budget, or false zero-hard-FP claim.

methodological_limits: Source-free bounded necessary-condition study only. Development success does not establish language-level reasoning, broad causal discovery, novel scientific generalization, or independent scientific eligibility.
